messages:
Maya (Marketing): Quick thread — finalizing run-of-show for the May webinar. Need to lock demo windows, rehearsals, and a clear fallback for live model hiccups.
Chris (PM): Can we do one 6-min live demo + a 3-min pre-recorded in case of issues? keeps pacing tight.
Sam (DevRel): +1. Prefer live on Redwood Hosted; if latency spikes, fallback to pre-recorded clip or dedicated replica.
Priya (Ops): For fallback we need a hot swap endpoint and a linkable recording hosted on S3. I can provision the endpoint and a signed url.
Erin (Speaker): I can shorten the live demo script to 4 steps so we can fail fast to prerecorded if needed. Draft below:
Erin (Speaker): 1) prompt intro 2) call Redwood API 3) show token cost/latency 4) one follow-up prompt
Maya (Marketing): Perfect. Sam can you prep a minimal script and a terminal demo snippet we can paste into the deck?
Sam (DevRel): Yep. Draft CLI snippet:
Sam (DevRel): ```bash
# run a short generation for the demo
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-1-small","prompt":"Summarize the following: ...","max_tokens":60}'
```
Priya (Ops): Ops checklist: ensure dedicated capacity route and a lower-tier hosted route for backup. I'll add autoscale rules and a routed alias `webinar-demo.redwood.ai` so we can flip in 30s.
Maya (Marketing): Awesome. Rehearsal schedule proposal:
- Fri 11am PT: dry run (speakers + stage ops)
- Mon 2pm PT: full dress with staging deck and live audience
- Wed 9am PT (day of): 30-min tech check + greenroom
Chris (PM): Add a 10-min buffer after demo to discuss cost/latency Qs and to show trace screenshots from Console.
Erin (Speaker): For the prerecorded clip, I'll record the same flow twice (clean and annotated) — store both with timestamps so we can pick.
Maya (Marketing): Promotion copy needs a sentence about "live demo & best-practices for stable inference". I'll draft and post by EOD.
Sam (DevRel): One more: include a small local mock server script for offline rehearsals. I'll attach to the repo.
Priya (Ops): I'll create the signed S3 urls and the routed alias by tomorrow EOD. tagging @Sam to confirm the mock server path. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deployment to staging cluster succeeded (deploy-2023-05-12-1145).
Maya (Marketing): Next steps: Sam — demo snippet + mock server by Thu. Priya — alias + fallback endpoint + signed urls by Thu EOD. Erin — prerecord clips by Fri morning. Chris — add buffer to run-of-show. I'll collate and send updated run-of-show doc. :raised_hands:
Chris (PM): Sounds good. If anything is at risk, shout here and we'll triage.
Erin (Speaker): All set from my side, will post recording link here when done.
Maya (Marketing): Thanks team — closing this thread after assets are posted. Reminder: rehearsals are mandatory for panel and speaker leads.
